settings.stack_mobile: Text above the image on mobile

info.background_video: Plays muted on a loop behind the content. The image shows while it loads and for shoppers who prefer reduced motion
info.price_label: [price] is replaced with the lowest subscription price, or the product price
info.sticky_spotlight_mobile: Once the shopper scrolls past the hero, the product card stays at the bottom of the screen on mobile
info.stack_mobile: On mobile the text sits on the background colour and the image follows it
info.spotlight_image: Leave empty to use the product's main image.
